messages:
maya: Heads up — g2-14 (us-west1) flapped overnight during the soak. Seeing repeated Xid 13 and a few ECC corrected spikes. Put node in drain but wanted to coordinate the burn-in rerun and kernel/driver variants to try.
arjun: Ugh. Any pattern on workload or seq_len? quick grep?
maya: Mostly steady synthetic streaming (long sequences) from soakbench. attached last 2 hours snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T03:10:12Z] Xid 13, GPU 0, ctx 0x12f
[2026-03-18T03:12:08Z] ECC corrected 24 single-bit, device 0
[2026-03-18T03:37:40Z] Xid 13, GPU 0, ctx 0x13b
```
burnin-bot: alert: node g2-14 registered 5 Xid13 events and 42 corrected ECC since 2026-03-17T22:00Z. Current state: quarantined.
liam: I can take this. Plan: re-run targeted soak with kernel-variant combos + memtest for 6h, then thermal cycling. If flake reproduces with different kernels it's HW-y.
sofia: Suggest we try kernel v5.10 (current), v5.15 (known stable), and the hotpatch we tested last month. Also test with CUDA 12.1 and 12.2 to rule driver/abi mismatch.
arjun: Agree. Also run a KV-cache-heavy prompt pattern to exercise large sequence offsets. Batching and KV behavior can expose stale mem region bugs.
devon: We'll need capacity though — pulling one g2 reduces available capacity for us-west prod. Cost impact: reallocating two extra preemptible g2s for the 12h soak ~ ~$120/day. Is that ok?
maya: We have reserved slack in dedicated pool for this week (SRE budget signoff). Go ahead but keep it to minimal extra nodes.
liam: Proposed soak matrix (short):\n- Phase A: 6h memtest (memtest-gpu --pattern staggered)
- Phase B: 8h soakbench long-seq (batch sizes 1, 4) on kernel v5.10 + CUDA12.1
- Phase C: repeat Phase B on kernel v5.15 + CUDA12.1
- Phase D: repeat Phase B on kernel v5.15 + CUDA12.2
- Phase E: thermal cycle 2x (power off 2min, power on) and rerun Phase B 4h
sofia: Add logs capture: nvidia-smi -q -d ECC, dmesg -T | grep -i xid, /var/log/soak/soakbench.log. Also enable per-token tracing in the harness for the span that fails.
arjun: If Xid persists across kernel/driver combos, escalate to hardware swap/RMA. If it only fails under v5.10 but not v5.15, document as kernel regression and open bug with kernel/driver upstream.
devon: Heads-up for scheduling: Canary headroom in us-west is ~2 GPU nodes today. If we take g2-14 offline and add 2 preemptible nodes we'll hit autoscaler thresholds — I can pin the soak workload to separate hostgroup to avoid autoscaler churn.
liam: Good. I'll push a soak job spec:
```
soakctl start --node g2-14 --matrix kernels=[5.10,5.15] cuda=[12.1,12.2] --phases memtest,soak,thermal --duration 32h --trace /var/log/soak/g2-14-trace.json
```
maya: Please make the run id and logs available in the ticket (INC-8321). Put results summary in #eng-infra when done. If we get >3 Xid13s in a 6h window on any phase, escalate.
burnin-bot: kickoff accepted: run 20260318-3789 queued. ETA start 2026-03-18T08:00:00Z.
sofia: Quick tip — when you run memtest, pin to single process per GPU to avoid kernel preemption noise: `taskset -c 2 soak-memtest --gpu 0 --singleproc`.
arjun: Also collect thermals every 30s: `watch -n30 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu --format=csv` — thermal spikes correlate with ECC.
liam: Noted. I'll update the soakctl spec and assign myself. Will annotate the run with the serial number and last RMA history.
maya: Thanks all. If this reproduces consistently we'll quarantine the whole board and order replacement. If it does not reproduce after full matrix, we'll unlock and return to service with extended monitoring for 7 days.
devon: Scheduling note: If RMA required, vendor lead time ~7 business days. I'll start the PO if we need it.
liam: Starting run now (manual kick because CLI scheduling window). Posting incremental logs to /var/log/soak/g2-14/.
sofia: ping if you need me to run hardware diags on the bench later :wrench:.
maya: Thanks team — keep replies short here for the audit trail.
